newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market cautious, lacking direction.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market cautious, lacking direction.

text.p: A directionless Bradford wool market saw tops traders unwilling to play their hands ahead of price signals from the major raw wool auctions, local sources said.
"There are practically no clear opinions either way on how prices will move and noone seems to be placing orders in anticipation," one said.
Prices for all types were quoted unchanged.
Several sources said they were waiting for wool values to be tested in Australia on Tuesday, while others were watching New Zealand, unhappy about the softer close there just before Christmas.
The retail sales figures for the Christmas period are being keenly awaited by suppliers of clothing quality tops as an indication of prospective U.K. demand.
But exporters complain that the sturdy pound has cast a black cloud over the horizon with overseas buyers bidding at unsustainable rates.
